taxonomic_note: Current POWO/WCVP accepts Argythamnia simulans; Ditaxis simulans is a homotypic synonym.
look_here_first: Start with sessile leaves and a long 3.5–12 cm axillary inflorescence. The key split from A. aphoroides is that A. simulans inflorescences are bisexual, then confirm with only 7–8 stamens.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays and Travis are exact target-zone records. The older PASS label was inconsistent with the project's three-county rule; no third qualifying county is currently locked.

approval_exception.reason: Learner inclusion is independent from native-range certification; correct stale PASS to two-county HOLD.

best_field_traits: staminate flowers with 7–8 stamens and no staminodes
seeds 3.5–4.2 mm, faintly and irregularly alveolate
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Use sessile leaves + long raceme to leave A. humilis behind, then use bisexual inflorescence + 7–8 stamens to separate from A. aphoroides.
morphology_keys.staminate_flower: Sepals 4–5.3 mm; petals 2–4 mm; 7–8 stamens; 0 staminodes. Petal attachment to the androphore is variable and not a safe binary.
morphology_keys.pistillate_flower: Sepals 6–9 mm; styles 1.5–2.1 mm, glabrous; stigmas flattened
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Capsules 3.5–9 mm, hispidulous; seeds 3.5–4.2 mm, faintly and irregularly alveolate

comparisons.key_distinctions: Use sessile leaves + 3.5–12 cm raceme first. Then confirm that the inflorescence is bisexual and the staminate flower has 7–8 stamens; this separates it from unisexual, 10-stamen A. aphoroides.

photo_note: Final diagnostic photo/license lock remains later polish.

field_diagnostics.single_best_trait: Sessile leaves + long bisexual raceme + 7–8 stamens.
fastest_traits: Staminate flowers with 7–8 stamens and no staminodes

look_alikes.distinction: A. humilis has a 2–10 mm petiole and tiny 0.7–0.9 cm raceme.
Both have sessile leaves and long racemes. A. simulans has bisexual inflorescences and 7–8 stamens; A. aphoroides has unisexual inflorescences and 10 stamens.

unreliable_alone: long raceme without checking sex arrangement

diagnostic_photo_targets: Bisexual raceme with staminate and pistillate flowers labeled
